about: Wave VCST-6122-wave2 (2026-10-01): 43 asks by six Sonnet-class agents against vcst-6122-schema2 with ranker verdict-1; every ask ended ambiguous and was closed by kb_show or kb_none BY HANDLE (log/20261001-b01b5d39.jsonl on the branch).
